title: GOD SAW THAT IT WAS GOOD

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: God made the wild animals according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and all the creatures that move along the ground according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good. - Gen 1:25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This verse shows God carrying out exactly what He spoke in the verse before. He said, "Let the land produce living creatures," and now we are told that God made them, the wild animals, the livestock, and every creature that moves along the ground. What God declares, God performs. His word and His work are always perfectly matched.

Once again we meet that lovely refrain: "God saw that it was good." All through this chapter, God pauses to delight in what He has made. He is not a distant, cold Creator who makes things carelessly. He looks over each part of His creation with pleasure, calling it good. Every creature, great and small, meets His approval.

There is something tender in this. The God who takes time to delight in the animals is a God who takes delight in His works. And if He looks upon the creatures with such care, how attentively He watches over His people, made in His image.

Jesus reminded us of this. Not one sparrow falls to the ground apart from the Father, and we are worth far more than many sparrows (Mt 10:29-31). The God who called the animals good is the God who counts the very hairs of your head. You are known, seen, and valued by your Maker.

Let the goodness woven through creation assure you of the goodness of the God who made you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does it comfort you to know that God delights in what He makes, including you?
2. How can God's care for the smallest creatures strengthen your trust in His care for you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You made all things and saw that they were good. Thank You for Your tender care over all creation, and for watching over me with even greater love. Amen.
